title: From the Depth

outfit_card.silhouette: A layered A-line gown with a cascading asymmetric hemline, featuring a fitted corset bodice, sheer draped overlays, and off-shoulder draped sleeves that create a soft, ethereal volume.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A delicate pearl-encrusted blindfold with fine lace trim, paired with tiny pearl clusters and silver hairpins tucked into the flowing waves.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A strapless sweetheart bodice wrapped in sheer, shimmering blue organza with pearl and crystal beadwork, featuring draped off-shoulder sleeves of tulle with scalloped lace edging and cascading pearl chains.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A tiered, floor-length skirt of iridescent blue chiffon with ruffled layers, finished with delicate scalloped lace trim and a subtle bustle effect at the back, worn with silver strappy heels.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating pearl strands, delicate silver chains, and translucent ribbon-like drapes that mimic ocean currents and sea foam.
